about: The Mask's gift list (defaults). Read top to bottom: a row with "gift" matches that gift by name and wins; rows with "upTo" are coin ranges (coins per gift); the last row catches everything bigger. Effects: chip (small), barrage (mid), grow (big), shatter (biggest). The owner's own list is saved from the VTuber window (More, Gifts) into gifts-owner.json, which wins over this file and is not tracked.
